zoe (DevEx): quick ping - seeing multiple support threads where onboarding hits an opaque SDK error. sample-app shows "Request failed" with no hint.

omar (SDK): can you paste one example payload?

zoe (DevEx): API returned 429 with body: {"error":"rate_limited","retry_after":10,"detail":"burst limit"} but SDK threw generic Error('429') and no retry info.

jia (sample-app): users just see a toast and try again immediately; bad first impression.

omar (SDK): agreed we should expose a stable error shape. proposal: { code: 'ERR_RATE_LIMIT', status: 429, message: 'Rate limited', hints: ['burst limit'], retry_after: 10, is_retryable: true }

pat (PM): thumbs up. also docs: add a short sentence in quickstart "If you see ERR_RATE_LIMIT, wait the suggested backoff instead of retrying immediately."

zoe (DevEx): small UX ask: sample quickstart should read `.hints[0]` and show it inline. don't attempt refresh for auth errors unless `is_retryable=true`.

omar (SDK): will add typed Error subclasses in Node/Python/Go with `.code`, `.status`, `.message`, `.hints` (string[]), `.retry_after` (optional number), `.is_retryable`. also adding `shouldRetry(err)` util with default policy: retry for 5xx and ERR_RATE_LIMIT; never for ERR_AUTH/ERR_VALIDATION/ERR_QUOTA.

jia (sample-app): I'll patch quickstart to show hint and respect `shouldRetry`. will add a unit test mocking 429 with hint.

ci-bot: CI: sample-app tests failing on branch fix/error-shape - 1 failing test (expecting retry_after handling).

omar (SDK): I'll open PRs for SDK changes + tests this sprint. tagging `devex` when ready.

pat (PM): filing RFC note and migration guidance - we will add `error.code` to responses; SDKs will keep legacy behavior for one release.

zoe (DevEx): thanks team. follow-up: surface `code` + `hints` in Console error view to speed debugging.
